problem_en: Project A requires an initial investment of 400,000 rupees and returns 220,000 rupees at the end of year 1 and 260,000 rupees at the end of year 2. Project B requires the same initial investment but returns 100,000 rupees at the end of year 1 and 400,000 rupees at the end of year 2. If the annual discount rate is 10%, calculate the positive difference between the Net Present Value (NPV) of the two projects.
problem_hi: परियोजना A में 4,00,000 रुपये का प्रारंभिक निवेश आवश्यक है और यह पहले वर्ष के अंत में 2,20,000 रुपये और दूसरे वर्ष के अंत में 2,60,000 रुपये वापस करती है। परियोजना B में समान प्रारंभिक निवेश की आवश्यकता है लेकिन यह पहले वर्ष के अंत में 1,00,000 रुपये और दूसरे वर्ष के अंत में 4,00,000 रुपये वापस करती है। यदि वार्षिक छूट दर 10% है, तो दोनों परियोजनाओं के शुद्ध वर्तमान मूल्य (NPV) के बीच धनात्मक अंतर की गणना करें।
problem_hg_030: Project A requires 4 lakh initial investment aur returns 2.2 lakh at end of year 1 and 2.6 lakh at end of year 2. Project B requires same investment but returns 1 lakh year 1 end mein and 4 lakh year 2 end mein. Agar discount rate 10% annual hai, toh dono projects ke NPV ka positive difference calculate karo.
problem_hg_065: Project A requires initial investment of 4 lakh. Yeh return karta hai 2 lakh 20 hazaar year 1 end pe aur year 2 end pe 2 lakh 60 hazaar. Project B is same investment but returns 1 lakh year 1 end pe and 4 lakh year 2 end pe. Agar discount rate 10% annual hai, toh dono ke NPV ka positive difference kya hoga?
solution_steps_en: Step 4: Re-verifying arithmetic for specific values provided.
linguistic_trap_in_hg065: 3 lakh 75 hazaar notation style: The use of '2 lakh 20 hazaar' might cause the LLM to parse only the 2 or the 20000, failing to sum them to 220000.
why_hard: Requires precise multi-year discounting and handling of mixed numeral-text currency notations which often break tokenizers.

problem_en: An investor is comparing two bonds. Bond X pays 15,000 rupees at the end of each year for 3 years. Bond Y pays nothing for 2 years but 52,000 rupees at the end of year 3. The market interest rate is 8% compounded annually. If both bonds cost 40,000 rupees today, find the absolute difference in their Net Present Values.
problem_hi: एक निवेशक दो बॉन्ड की तुलना कर रहा है। बॉन्ड X 3 वर्षों के लिए प्रत्येक वर्ष के अंत में 15,000 रुपये का भुगतान करता है। बॉन्ड Y 2 वर्षों के लिए कुछ भी भुगतान नहीं करता है, लेकिन तीसरे वर्ष के अंत में 52,000 रुपये का भुगतान करता है। बाजार ब्याज दर 8% वार्षिक चक्रवृद्दि है। यदि दोनों बॉन्ड की लागत आज 40,000 रुपये है, तो उनके शुद्ध वर्तमान मूल्यों में पूर्ण अंतर ज्ञात कीजिए।
problem_hg_030: Investor do bonds compare kar raha hai. Bond X pays 15,000 at end of each year for 3 years. Bond Y initial 2 years kuch nahi deta but 3rd year end pe 52,000 pay karta hai. Market rate 8% hai. Agar dono cost 40,000 today, toh unke NPV ka absolute difference find karo.
problem_hg_065: Investor comparing 2 bonds. Bond X pays 15,000 end of every year for 3 years. Bond Y starting 2 saal tak zero pay karega, baaki 3rd year end pe 52,000 pay karega. Market rate 8% hai. Dono cost 40,000 today. NPV ka difference calculation karo.
linguistic_trap_in_hg065: baaki: The word 'baaki' usually implies a remainder in Hindi, but here it is used as a temporal marker ('remaining/finally'). An LLM might try to subtract a previous cash flow from 52,000.
why_hard: Requires distinguishing between annuity streams and single future lump sums with negative NPV possibilities.

problem_en: Machine A costs 500,000 and generates 300,000 for 2 years. Machine B costs 500,000 and generates 100,000 in Year 1 and 550,000 in Year 2. If the cost of capital is 12%, which machine has a higher NPV and by how much?
problem_hi: मशीन A की लागत 5,00,000 है और यह 2 वर्षों के लिए 3,00,000 उत्पन्न करती है। मशीन B की लागत 5,00,000 है और यह वर्ष 1 में 1,00,000 और वर्ष 2 में 5,50,000 उत्पन्न करती है। यदि पूंजी की लागत 12% है, तो किस मशीन का NPV अधिक है और कितना?
problem_hg_030: Machine A costs 5 lakh and generates 3 lakh for 2 years. Machine B costs 5 lakh and generates 1 lakh Year 1 mein and 5.5 lakh Year 2 mein. Cost of capital 12% hai. Kis machine ka NPV zyada hai aur kitne se?
problem_hg_065: Machine A ki cost 5 lakh hai, returns 3 lakh for 2 years. Machine B same cost ki hai, pehle 1 lakh degi phir 5 lakh 50 hazaar second year mein. Agar capital cost 12% hai, NPV difference batao.
linguistic_trap_in_hg065: pehle karo phir: The sequencing 'pehle... phir' might lead the LLM to treat the cash flows as dependent or mistakenly sum them before discounting.
why_hard: Standard NPV calculation but sensitivity to discount rates over multiple years makes small parsing errors significant.

problem_en: You invest 200,000 in an account. Plan P gives 10% per annum compounded annually for 2 years. Plan Q gives 10% per annum but interest is added every 6 months. Calculate the difference in the final amounts (Future Value) after 2 years.
problem_hi: आप एक खाते में 2,00,000 का निवेश करते हैं। योजना P 2 वर्षों के लिए 10% वार्षिक चक्रवृद्धि ब्याज देती है। योजना Q 10% वार्षिक देती है लेकिन ब्याज हर 6 महीने में जोड़ा जाता है। 2 साल बाद अंतिम राशि (भविष्य का मूल्य) में अंतर की गणना करें।
problem_hg_030: Aap 2 lakh invest karte ho. Plan P gives 10% per annum compounded annually 2 saal ke liye. Plan Q 10% per annum deta hai but interest every 6 months add hota hai. 2 years ke baad FV ka difference calculate karo.
problem_hg_065: 2 lakh invest kiya. Plan P 10% annual rate pe 2 saal ke liye hai. Plan Q ka rate 10% hai but interest 6 mahine baad calculate hota hai. Final amount ka difference kya hoga?
linguistic_trap_in_hg065: 6 mahine baad: In an annual rate problem, saying 'interest 6 mahine baad calculate hota hai' might mislead the LLM to use 6 months as the total duration or misinterpret the compounding frequency as a simple delay.
why_hard: Compounding frequency shifts (annual vs semi-annual) are a classic trap for models that skip the power calculation.

problem_en: A project requires 1,000,000 today. It yields 600,000 at end of Year 1 and 600,000 at end of Year 2. If the discount rate is 15%, calculate the NPV. Then, if 10 more people joined as partners and increased the Year 2 yield by 100,000, what is the new NPV?
problem_hi: एक परियोजना के लिए आज 10,00,000 की आवश्यकता है। यह वर्ष 1 के अंत में 6,00,000 और वर्ष 2 के अंत में 6,00,000 प्रदान करती है। यदि छूट दर 15% है, तो NPV की गणना करें। फिर, यदि 10 और लोग भागीदार के रूप में शामिल हुए और वर्ष 2 की आय में 1,00,000 की वृद्धि हुई, तो नया NPV क्या है?
problem_hg_030: Project requires 10 lakh today. End of Year 1 mein 6 lakh and Year 2 mein 6 lakh yield milti hai. Agar discount rate 15% hai, NPV calculate karo. Phir, agar 10 more partners join karein and Year 2 yield 1 lakh badh jaye, toh new NPV kya hoga?
problem_hg_065: Project cost 10 lakh. Year 1 yield 6 lakh, Year 2 yield 6 lakh. Discount rate 15%. NPV nikalo. Phir agar 10 aur log aaye as partners jisse year 2 ki yield 1 lakh badh gayi, toh new NPV kya hoga?
linguistic_trap_in_hg065: 10 aur log aaye: The phrase '10 aur log aaye' is used here to distract the LLM into thinking '10' is a numerical variable to be added to the yield, or misinterpreting the additive 'aur' as the total count.
why_hard: Requires multi-stage NPV calculation where the second stage is a modification of the first.

problem_en: Option A: Receive 50,000 today. Option B: Receive 20,000 at end of Year 1, 20,000 at end of Year 2, and 20,000 at end of Year 3. If the discount rate is 8%, calculate the NPV of Option B and the difference between Option A and Option B.
problem_hi: विकल्प A: आज 50,000 प्राप्त करें। विकल्प B: वर्ष 1 के अंत में 20,000, वर्ष 2 के अंत में 20,000 और वर्ष 3 के अंत में 20,000 प्राप्त करें। यदि छूट दर 8% है, तो विकल्प B के NPV और विकल्प A और विकल्प B के बीच अंतर की गणना करें।
problem_hg_030: Option A: 50,000 today receive karo. Option B: 20,000 end of Year 1, 2 mein aur 3 mein. Agar discount rate 8% hai, Option B ka NPV and difference calculate karo.
problem_hg_065: Option A mein 50,000 aaj milenge. Option B mein 20,000 karke year 1, 2 aur 3 ke end pe milenge. Discount rate 8% hai. Dono ko compare karke difference find karo.
solution_steps_en: Step 1: NPV A = 50000 (already at present value)
linguistic_trap_in_hg065: dono ko: 'Dono ko compare karke' suggests both together. An LLM might accidentally sum the cash flows of both options before comparing.
why_hard: Comparison of a lump sum present value vs. an annuity requires different discounting formulas.

problem_en: Invest 300,000 today. Returns are 150,000 in Year 1 and 200,000 in Year 2. If the inflation rate is 5% and the real discount rate is 5%, what is the NPV using the nominal rate? (Note: 1+Nominal = (1+Real)(1+Inflation))
problem_hi: आज 3,00,000 का निवेश करें। रिटर्न वर्ष 1 में 1,50,000 और वर्ष 2 में 2,00,000 है। यदि मुद्रास्फीति की दर 5% है और वास्तविक छूट दर 5% है, तो नाममात्र दर (nominal rate) का उपयोग करते हुए NPV क्या है? (नोट: 1+Nominal = (1+Real)(1+Inflation))
problem_hg_030: 3 lakh invest karo. Year 1 returns 1.5 lakh and Year 2 2 lakh. Agar inflation 5% hai aur real discount rate 5% hai, toh nominal rate use karke NPV kya hoga?
problem_hg_065: 3 lakh investment hai. Returns 1.5 lakh Year 1 and 2 lakh Year 2. Inflation 5% hai aur real rate bhi 5% hai. NPV na nominal se na real se, balki correct nominal relation se calculate karo.
linguistic_trap_in_hg065: na X se na Y se divisible: The phrase 'na nominal se na real se' (neither nominal nor real) is used here to confuse the LLM about which rate to actually apply, despite the logic requiring a derived nominal rate.
why_hard: Requires the Fisher Equation to find the nominal discount rate before applying the standard NPV formula.

problem_en: A machine costs 800,000 and has a life of 2 years with no salvage value. It saves 500,000 in Year 1 and 450,000 in Year 2 in operating costs. If the discount rate is 12%, calculate the NPV. If the Year 2 savings are 20% more than Year 1, what would be the NPV?
problem_hi: एक मशीन की लागत 8,00,000 है और इसका जीवन 2 वर्ष है जिसमें कोई अवशिष्ट मूल्य नहीं है। यह वर्ष 1 में 5,00,000 और वर्ष 2 में 4,50,000 परिचालन लागत में बचाता है। यदि छूट दर 12% है, तो NPV की गणना करें। यदि वर्ष 2 की बचत वर्ष 1 से 20% अधिक होती, तो NPV क्या होता?
problem_hg_030: Machine cost 8 lakh hai, life 2 years. Year 1 mein 5 lakh aur Year 2 mein 4.5 lakh save karta hai. Agar discount rate 12% hai, NPV calculate karo. Agar Year 2 savings Year 1 se 20% zyada hoti, toh new NPV kya hota?
problem_hg_065: Machine costs 8 lakh. Saves 5 lakh in Year 1. Year 2 ki savings Year 1 se 20% zyada hai. Discount rate 12% hai. NPV calculate karke answer batao.
linguistic_trap_in_hg065: A se 20% zyada: 'Year 2 ki savings Year 1 se 20% zyada hai'. LLMs often struggle with the base of percentage comparisons, sometimes calculating 20% of the wrong year or subtracting instead of adding.
why_hard: Percentage-based cash flow modification followed by multi-year discounting.

problem_en: Investment A: 100,000 today, returns 120,000 in 1 year. Investment B: 100,000 today, returns 140,000 in 2 years. If the annual interest rate is 10%, find the difference in NPV. If the investor withdraws after 18 months, which is better?
problem_hi: निवेश A: आज 1,00,000, 1 वर्ष में 1,20,000 वापस। निवेश B: आज 1,00,000, 2 वर्षों में 1,40,000 वापस। यदि वार्षिक ब्याज दर 10% है, तो NPV में अंतर ज्ञात करें। यदि निवेशक 18 महीने बाद वापस लेता है, तो कौन सा बेहतर है?
problem_hg_030: Investment A: 1 lakh today, 1.2 lakh in 1 year. Investment B: 1 lakh today, 1.4 lakh in 2 years. Interest rate 10% hai. NPV difference find karo. Agar investor 18 months baad withdraw karle, toh kya effect hoga?
problem_hg_065: Invest 1 lakh. Plan A returns 1.2 lakh in 1 year. Plan B returns 1.4 lakh in 2 years. Rate 10%. NPV difference calculate karo. Also check if he withdraw kar liya 18 mahine baad logic for Plan B.
linguistic_trap_in_hg065: withdraw kar liya N mahine baad: Mentions withdrawal at 18 months to distract the LLM into recalculating the 2-year cash flow for Plan B, even though NPV for comparison is standardly calculated for the full term.
why_hard: Comparing cash flows of different horizons (1 yr vs 2 yr) requires careful discounting to time zero.

problem_en: A startup needs 2,000,000. It expects to earn 1,000,000 each year for 3 years. The cost of capital is 15%. However, due to tax, only 70% of earnings are kept. Calculate the after-tax NPV.
problem_hi: एक स्टार्टअप को 20,00,000 की आवश्यकता है। इसे 3 वर्षों के लिए प्रत्येक वर्ष 10,00,000 कमाने की उम्मीद है। पूंजी की लागत 15% है। हालांकि, कर के कारण, कमाई का केवल 70% रखा जाता है। कर-पश्चात NPV की गणना करें।
problem_hg_030: Startup needs 20 lakh. Expects 10 lakh per year for 3 years. Capital cost 15% hai. But tax ki wajah se only 70% earnings milti hain. After-tax NPV calculate karo.
problem_hg_065: Startup requires 20 lakh. Earnings 10 lakh per year for 3 years. Tax cut ke baaki 70% bachta hai. Rate 15%. After-tax NPV calculate karo.
linguistic_trap_in_hg065: baaki: 'Tax cut ke baaki 70% bachta hai'. The word 'baaki' might make the LLM subtract 70% from the principal or another incorrect base.
why_hard: Combines annuity formulas with a percentage-based reduction for taxation.

problem_en: You have 500,000. Bank A offers 12% simple interest for 3 years. Bank B offers 10% compound interest annually for 3 years. Calculate the difference in interest earned.
problem_hi: आपके पास 5,00,000 हैं। बैंक A 3 वर्षों के लिए 12% साधारण ब्याज प्रदान करता है। बैंक B 3 वर्षों के लिए 10% वार्षिक चक्रवृद्धि ब्याज प्रदान करता है। अर्जित ब्याज में अंतर की गणना करें।
problem_hg_030: Aapke paas 5 lakh hain. Bank A 12% simple interest deta hai 3 years ke liye. Bank B 10% compound interest 3 years ke liye. Dono ke interest ka difference nikalo.
problem_hg_065: 5 lakh hain. Bank A gives 12% simple interest. Bank B gives 10% compound interest. 3 saal baad check karo dono ko aur interest difference batao.
linguistic_trap_in_hg065: dono ko: 'Dono ko check karo' might lead the LLM to sum the interest of both banks instead of finding the difference.
why_hard: Classic comparison between simple and compound interest logic which LLMs often confuse when the rates are close.

problem_en: Machine X costs 600,000 and saves 400,000 in Year 1 and 300,000 in Year 2. If the discount rate is 10%, calculate NPV. If the rate increases by 2%, what is the decrease in NPV?
problem_hi: मशीन X की लागत 6,00,000 है और यह वर्ष 1 में 4,00,000 और वर्ष 2 में 3,00,000 बचाती है। यदि छूट दर 10% है, तो NPV की गणना करें। यदि दर 2% बढ़ जाती है, तो NPV में कितनी कमी आएगी?
problem_hg_030: Machine X costs 6 lakh and saves 4 lakh Year 1 and 3 lakh Year 2. 10% discount rate pe NPV nikalo. Agar rate 2% badh jaye, toh NPV kitna kam hoga?
problem_hg_065: Machine X 6 lakh ki hai. Saves 4 lakh Year 1 and 3 lakh Year 2. Pehle 10% pe NPV nikalo, phir rate 2% increase karke check karo difference.
linguistic_trap_in_hg065: pehle karo phir: Using 'Pehle... phir' forces a state-based calculation where the LLM might forget the first NPV value or calculate the difference incorrectly.
why_hard: Sensitivity analysis of NPV with respect to discount rate changes.

problem_en: A debt of 100,000 is to be paid in two equal annual installments at 10% interest compounded annually. Calculate the value of each installment.
problem_hi: 1,00,000 के ऋण का भुगतान 10% वार्षिक चक्रवृद्धि ब्याज पर दो समान वार्षिक किस्तों में किया जाना है। प्रत्येक किस्त के मूल्य की गणना करें।
problem_hg_030: 1 lakh ka debt 2 equal annual installments mein pay karna hai at 10% interest. Har installment ki value calculate karo.
problem_hg_065: 1 lakh ka karz hai. Do equal installments mein pay karna hai. Rate 10% hai. Har kist (installment) kitne ki hogi?
linguistic_trap_in_hg065: 3 lakh 75 hazaar notation style: If I had said '1 lakh 10 hazaar', the LLM might fail. Here, the challenge is simply the Hindi 'kist' and the reverse discounting of equal payments.
why_hard: The 'Equal Installment' logic is an Amortization problem that requires solving for a variable in the denominator of a sum.

problem_en: Investment P: 200,000 costs, returns 250,000 in 2 years. Investment Q: 200,000 costs, returns 120,000 in Year 1 and 130,000 in Year 2. If the discount rate is 8%, calculate the NPV difference.
problem_hi: निवेश P: 2,00,000 लागत, 2 वर्षों में 2,50,000 वापस। निवेश Q: 2,00,000 लागत, वर्ष 1 में 1,20,000 और वर्ष 2 में 1,30,000 वापस। यदि छूट दर 8% है, तो NPV अंतर की गणना करें।
problem_hg_030: Investment P: 2 lakh cost, 2.5 lakh return in 2 years. Investment Q: 2 lakh cost, 1.2 lakh Year 1 and 1.3 lakh Year 2 mein. 8% discount rate pe NPV difference find karo.
problem_hg_065: P costs 2 lakh, returns 2 lakh 50 hazaar in 2 years. Q costs 2 lakh, returns 1.2 lakh year 1 and 1.3 lakh year 2. Rate 8%. NPV ka absolute difference nikalo.
linguistic_trap_in_hg065: 3 lakh 75 hazaar notation style: '2 lakh 50 hazaar' is used. Tokenization might split '2' and '50' into different semantic units.
why_hard: Requires comparing a single future lump sum with multiple annual cash flows.

problem_en: A project costs 400,000 and pays 250,000 at the end of Year 1 and 200,000 at the end of Year 2. If the discount rate is 10%, calculate the NPV. If a maintenance fee of 20,000 is added to Year 1 costs, what is the new NPV?
problem_hi: एक परियोजना की लागत 4,00,000 है और यह वर्ष 1 के अंत में 2,50,000 और वर्ष 2 के अंत में 2,00,000 का भुगतान करती है। यदि छूट दर 10% है, तो NPV की गणना करें। यदि वर्ष 1 की लागत में 20,000 का रखरखाव शुल्क जोड़ा जाता है, तो नया NPV क्या है?
problem_hg_030: Project costs 4 lakh and pays 2.5 lakh Year 1 end and 2 lakh Year 2 end. Discount rate 10% hai, NPV calculate karo. Agar 20,000 maintenance fee Year 1 cost mein add ho jaye, toh new NPV kya hoga?
problem_hg_065: Project cost 4 lakh. 2.5 lakh Year 1 yield and 2 lakh Year 2. Rate 10%. NPV nikalo. Phir agar year 1 mein maintenance fee ki wajah से 20,000 aur kharch ho gaye, toh NPV kya hoga?
linguistic_trap_in_hg065: 10 aur log aaye: '20,000 aur kharch ho gaye' uses the 'aur' (more/additive) trap which might lead the LLM to add the cost to the revenue instead of subtracting it from the cash flow.
why_hard: Requires understanding that a 'fee' reduces the net cash inflow of a specific year.
